title: Instance-Dependent Bandit Convex Optimization in One Dimension
abstract: arXiv:2611.31608v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the instance-dependent sample complexity of one-dimensional stochastic bandit convex optimization in the fixed-confidence setting. First, we consider minimizer localization, where the learner seeks to identify a point within distance $\varepsilon$ of the unique minimizer. We introduce a new instance-dependent quantity $\Delta_\varepsilon(f)$, corresponding to the threshold for which the sublevel set of $f-\min f$ has length $2\varepsilon$. We prove a lower bound of order $\Delta_\varepsilon(f)^{-2}$ and give a bisection-style algorithm that matches this rate up to logarithmic factors. We then revisit the simple-regret setting, where the goal is to identify an $\varepsilon$-optimal point. Surprisingly, no comparable instance-dependent improvement is possible: every correct algorithm has sample complexity of order $\varepsilon^{-2}$ on every instance, matching the minimax rate up to constants. translated_title: 一维实例依赖的赌博机凸优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一维随机赌博机凸优化在固定置信度设定下的实例依赖样本复杂度。首先，我们考虑极小值点定位问题，即学习者试图识别一个与唯一极小值点距离不超过 ε 的点。我们引入了一个新的实例依赖量 Δ_ε(f)，它对应于 f−min f 的下水平集长度为 2ε 的阈值。我们证明了量级为 Δ_ε(f)^{-2} 的下界，并给出一种二分类式的算法，该算法在对数因子范围内匹配这一速率。随后，我们重新审视简单遗憾设定，其目标是识别一个 ε-最优点。令人惊讶的是，在此设定下不可能获得可比的实例依赖改进：每个正确的算法在每个实例上的样本复杂度均为 ε^{-2} 量级，在常数因子内匹配极小极大速率。这些结果共同区分了这两种设定。
tldr: 本文在一维赌博机凸优化中首次刻画了实例依赖样本复杂度，引入新量 Δ_ε(f) 证明定位极小值点问题可获得依赖该量的加速，同时惊人地发现简单遗憾设定下不存在任何实例依赖的改进。
